metadata.description: Repository accompanying 'Correcting for instrument overlap in two-step summary-data Mendelian randomization mediation: a closed-form covariance and its empirical prevalence'. Contains (1) the diagnostic tool estimate_cov_prod_mr() (R) and its TwoSampleMR- and ieugwasr-compatible wrappers; (2) validation scripts (180-cell coverage grid, 12-cell targeted sweep, bootstrap fallback); (3) the all-Python Phase-B batch re-estimation pipeline (OpenGWAS REST /tophits + /associations, harmonized IVW, S10 correction) and the 113-study recomputation outputs; (4) the inter-coder reliability work package (blind re-coding template, sealed answer key, compute_kappa_2nd.py); (5) the literature coding table and codebook; (6) the PRISMA literature-audit flow and figures. The closed-form Cov(alpha_hat, beta_hat) corrects the variance of the product-method indirect effect under shared instruments (n_s > 0) and mediator-outcome sample overlap (rho_MY > 0).
